hub.notes: Theme menu: pick a look for the Hub and every askp plugin.

plugins.name: V/A
plugins.tagline: Analog-style channel strip: up to sixteen slots of Pre, Tape, Comp, Tone, Space, Echo, Drive, Amp, Pitch and more.
plugins.notes: 0.6.0: Shared askp themes: theme menu next to the light/dark button, one choice for all askp plugins. Sibil device shows the standalone's timeline graph and S Balance line. 0.5.1: a Hide graph button folds the graph into a slim bar so the knobs fill the panel (open by default, saved per session). 0.5.0: every control on screen; band EQ is now Tone with Character, Tube and Tilt.

plugins.name: V/A Lab
plugins.tagline: Tester build of V/A with a Tuning panel: adjust every character's numbers by ear and export them.
plugins.notes: 0.6.0: Shared askp themes: theme menu next to the light/dark button, one choice for all askp plugins. 0.5.1: built on V/A 0.5.1 (Hide graph button).

plugins.name: Sector
plugins.tagline: Split a mix by stereo position and frequency, and send each part to its own output.
plugins.notes: 0.2.0: Shared askp themes: theme menu next to the light/dark button, one choice for all askp plugins. 0.1.1: host bypass now stays in time with the plugin's latency (Bypass and Deactivate sound the same).

plugins.name: Sibil
plugins.tagline: A de-esser that hears the difference between S, SH and T, and links across a vocal stack.
plugins.notes: 0.2.0: Shared askp themes: theme menu next to the light/dark button, one choice for all askp plugins. Host parameter text round-trips correctly. 0.1.1: Host parameter text now recalls the displayed breath and plosive attenuation correctly.

plugins.name: Taste
plugins.tagline: Build a taste profile from your own mixes and pull new mixes towards it.
plugins.notes: 0.2.0: Shared askp themes: theme menu next to the light/dark button, one choice for all askp plugins. Host parameter text round-trips correctly. 0.1.1: Host parameter text now recalls the displayed Exaggerate multiplier.

plugins.name: Grille
plugins.tagline: Guitar and bass amp, cab and mic IRs on three morphing pads.
plugins.notes: 0.2.0: Shared askp themes: theme menu next to the light/dark button, one choice for all askp plugins. Host parameter text round-trips correctly. First test build. Bundled cab IRs: Brit 4x12 and Rect 4x12 from Jester Dyne Productions (CC0); Thick 2x12: IR: Darwin's Cat, darwinscat.com (CC BY 4.0). Full credits and licences are in the download zip.

plugins.name: Atrium
plugins.tagline: Draw a room, place every track in it, and walk a listener through it.
plugins.notes: 0.1.0: First test build. One plugin, two roles: a Room on a bus (room size, wall materials, listener, reverb tail) and a Source on each track (place it in the room). Sources send Listener Pan / Gain / Tone to the DAW so moving the listener can be recorded as automation. Use the same format (VST3, AU or CLAP) for the Room and its Sources.
